from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import json,requests,hashlib,time,threading
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_bank_release_vintage_and_nim_definition_probe_v1")
protocol=json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ledger=json.loads((OUT/"request_ledger.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
tasks=[
("https://www.nfra.gov.cn/cn/static/data/DocInfo/SelectByDocId/data_docId=1221429.json","官方正文_data_docId=1221429.json","搜索命中2025Q2旧PDF的同docId公开正文接口；不重试旧PDF失败URL"),
("https://www.pbc.gov.cn/yanjiuju/fileDir/resource/cms/2016/04/2016040818034521342.pdf","人民银行工作论文_2016_4.pdf","搜索命中的官方研究论文，核实际口径，不预先当监管净息差定义")]
assert len(ledger)+len(tasks)<=10
assert not {x[0] for x in tasks}&({x["url"] for x in ledger}|set(protocol["known_failed_urls_do_not_retry"]))
remaining=16777216-sum(x.get("bytes",0) for x in ledger);used=0;lock=threading.Lock()
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def fetch(task):
 global used
 url,name,role=task
 x={"url":url,"role":role,"started_at":now(),"retry":False,"raw_saved":False}
 try:
  r=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,25),stream=True,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
  x.update({"status":r.status_code,"final_url":r.url,"headers":dict(r.headers)})
  r.raise_for_status();chunks=[];start=time.monotonic()
  for b in r.iter_content(65536):
   with lock:
    used+=len(b)
    if used>remaining:raise RuntimeError("已达总字节上限")
   if time.monotonic()-start>35:raise RuntimeError("已达下载时间上限")
   chunks.append(b)
  raw=b"".join(chunks);(OUT/name).write_bytes(raw)
  x.update({"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"raw_path":(OUT/name).as_posix(),"raw_saved":True,"magic_hex":raw[:12].hex()})
  if name.endswith(".json"):
   data=json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8")).get("data",{})
   x["metadata"]={k:v for k,v in data.items() if k not in ["docClob","listTwoItem"]}
  if name.endswith(".pdf"):assert raw.startswith(b"%PDF"),"非PDF载体，不能当原论文"
 except Exception as e:x["error"]=type(e).__name__+": "+str(e)
 x["completed_at"]=now();return x
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:results=list(pool.map(fetch,tasks))
ledger.extend(results)
(OUT/"request_ledger.json").write_text(json.dumps(ledger,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"两源实际读取":results,"唯一直链":len(ledger)},ensure_ascii=False))
